title: bci-membrane-latch: a toy fail-closed OES-32 residual gate between synthetic EEG-like signal quality and hologram intents
description:
Toy simulation; all data SYNTHETIC. A standard-library Python model of a fail-closed latch between a seeded, synthetic EEG-like signal-quality value and four hologram UI intents (yes, no, next, help). An intent fires only when a reference is seated, the OES-32 residual R = maxi |x[i] − xref[i]| over 32 components is at most 0.08, and a stub decoder confidence is a finite number in [0.6, 1.0]. Anything else holds. Includes 49 tests and a byte-exact demo snapshot, run in CI on Python 3.10–3.13.

Not a medical device. Synthetic EEG-like signals only; no real EEG, headset or person is involved. Not for diagnosis, treatment or monitoring, and no health, efficacy or accessibility-outcome claim is made.

Relationship to ADR-001. residual() follows the normative definition in oes32-residual; this repository is a downstream consumer, not a normative source. The tolerance 0.08 is a toy value and is not calibrated to anything.

Evidence tags. Demo output and test vectors: SYNTHETIC. Any real EEG, headset or user result: UNRUN (none exists). Tags follow sparkainlp-x/.github.
